messages:
alex: heads up - saw a spike in fncall schema rejects on /compose route after prefix-compression rollout
maria: logs?
alex: snippet:

```
WARN 2026-03-20T14:12:03Z adapter=kv-cache id=adp-78 fncall_parse_error: expected object, got string
TRACE req=1766123456 route=compose model=redwood-4k variant=bloom q=0.8 adapter_chain=[adp-78,adp-http]
```

devon: kv-cache is first in chain, we flipped prefix-compression for small payloads in last deploy
maria: validator expects an object but we're getting the entire tool args serialized into a string (looks like the adapter double-serialized payload)
jordan: are these rejects causing routing fallbacks? dashboard shows a degen/fallback spike for compose
alex: yes, we see increased fallback counts and quota consumption for the degen tier
telemetry-bot: alert: fncall.schema_reject_rate increased by 470% over 30m
maria: mitigation options: rollback prefix-compression, or add a decode step post-kv-cache before schema validation
devon: short term: include adapter_id and decode_status in traces so Console can surface which adapter mutated the payload
alex: and add a dashboard tile showing adapter chain + first validator error for each request
jordan: UX suggestion: show first-error inline and a "view raw chain" link to expand full adapter traces
maria: opened PR #4329 to add a post-kv decode step and an adapter.decode_map flag, also adding adapter_id to stats proto
devon: propose canary rollout plan: 10% -> monitor 15m -> 50% -> 100% with automated reject gating
alex: will monitor billing/routing metrics during the canary. tagging ENG-8002 for dashboard work :thumbsup:
